en.description:
Play without ads if you like: none between levels, no banners, and a short video only when you ask for one.

Tap an arrow and it glides out, snake-like, along its own path, as long as nothing stands in its way. Clear every arrow in the right order and the board reveals the picture it was all along: a cat, a hot-air balloon, the Matterhorn.

Arrowgami is a relaxing logic puzzle and brain teaser about looking ahead. Every board is a picture folded out of arrows, like origami. Untangle the maze: find the arrow that can escape, unblock the next one, and watch the shape unfold.

• Always solvable: every board can be cleared, and the hardest have exactly one solution. No guessing, just thinking.
• Four difficulties: Normal, Tricky, Fiendish and Diabolical, from a calm warm-up for the mind to riddles that stretch your IQ, and boards of four kinds: coils, long lines, crowds of short arrows and the classic mix.
• A daily challenge: a new puzzle every day, in its own picture on holidays from around the world, with a calendar, a streak and a cup for every month you complete. Every weekend, a big board as well. Compare your time with everyone who solved it.
• Over 1,000 pictures to collect, lighting up in colour, in fifteen albums: animals and dinosaurs, food, places, sports, celebrations and a few Swiss favourites.
• Weekly leagues under a name and flag of your choice, with your Game Center friends marked.
• Send a level or the daily challenge with your time to beat and your solve to race: your arrows fly beside your friend's as faint ghosts. Even without the game, it plays right away.
• Medals with ten ranks each, best times for every level, and Game Center achievements and leaderboards.
• Three hearts per level, two on the hardest: a blocked arrow bounces back and costs one.
• Hints when you're stuck, and more at every streak milestone.
• On Apple Watch too: boards made for the wrist, each a picture, that count for your streak, the leagues and your collection, and a complication with your streak for the watch face.
• Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed. Progress syncs through iCloud across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with widgets for the Home and Lock Screen.
• Supports VoiceOver, Voice Control, Reduce Motion, Bold Text, the largest text sizes and Increase Contrast.

Arrowgami is free, and a short video only plays when you ask for one, for an extra hint or to refill your hearts and keep going. The shop also has streak freezers, which save your daily streak on a day you miss, the Board Themes pack, four places to play in by day and by night, the Masterpieces pack, six famous paintings behind your board, and a tip jar if you'd like to say thanks.

Download Arrowgami now and untangle your first picture.
en.releaseNotes:
• Gentler start: no hearts lost on levels 1 and 2, and bigger tips
• Game Center asks after level 4, not at first launch
• Your new name and flag now show on daily challenge times

en.subtitle: Tap Away to Reveal Pictures

ja.description:
広告なしで遊べます。レベルの合間の広告もバナーもなく、短い動画が流れるのは自分で選んだときだけです。

矢印をタップすると、行く手に何もなければ、ヘビのように自分のルートに沿って滑り出ていきます。すべての矢印を正しい順番で消すと、盤面はずっと隠していた絵を見せてくれます。ネコ、熱気球、マッターホルン。

Arrowgamiは、先を読む力が試される、ほっとできるロジックパズル＆脳トレです。どの盤面も、折り紙のように矢印で折られた一枚の絵。迷路をほどくように、外へ出られる矢印を見つけ、次の矢印を自由にして、形が現れるのを見届けましょう。

• 必ず解ける：どの盤面もクリアでき、最難関の盤面は答えがただ1つ。当てずっぽうは不要、考えるだけです。
• 4つの難易度：「ふつう」「難しい」「超難しい」「鬼」。頭のウォーミングアップから、IQが試される難問まで。盤面は4種類：コイル、長いライン、短い矢印がひしめくクラウド、そしてクラシックのミックス。
• デイリーチャレンジ：毎日新しいパズルが登場。世界各地の祝日にはその日だけの絵になります。カレンダーと連続記録つきで、すべてクリアした月にはトロフィーがもらえます。さらに毎週末には大きな週末パズルも。クリアした全員とタイムを比べられます。
• 集めたくなる1,000点以上のイラストは、色づいて輝き、15のアルバムに収まります：動物や恐竜、食べ物、名所、スポーツ、行事、そしてスイスならではのお気に入りも。
• 好きな名前と国旗で参加する週間リーグ。Game Centerの友だちには印がつきます。
• レベルやデイリーチャレンジを、超えるべき自分のタイムとプレイつきで送れます。あなたの矢がゴーストとして薄く一緒に飛びます。ゲームがなくても、すぐに遊べます。
• 各10ランクのメダル、全レベルのベストタイム、Game Centerの達成項目とリーダーボード。
• 1レベルにつきハートは3つ（最難関は2つ）：ふさがれた矢印は跳ね返り、ハートが1つ減ります。
• 行き詰まったときはヒント。連続記録のマイルストーンごとにもらえます。
• Apple Watchにも対応：手首に合わせた盤面で、どれもイラストになっています。連続記録、リーグ、コレクションにカウントされ、文字盤には連続記録を表示するコンプリケーションもあります。
• オフラインでプレイでき、Wi-Fiは不要。進行状況はiCloudでiPhone、iPad、Apple Watchの間で同期され、ホーム画面とロック画面のウィジェットもあります。
• VoiceOver、「音声コントロール」、「視差効果を減らす」、「文字を太くする」、最大の文字サイズ、「コントラストを上げる」に対応。

Arrowgamiは無料で、短い動画が流れるのは、ヒントをもう1つ増やしたいときや、ハートを回復して続けたいときなど、自分で選んだときだけです。ショップでは、プレイできなかった日にも毎日の連続記録を守る「連続記録フリーズ」、「盤面テーマ」パック、昼と夜の4つの遊び場、6つの名画を盤面の背景にする「名画」パック、そしてお礼の気持ちを伝えるチップも用意しています。

今すぐArrowgamiをダウンロードして、最初の1枚をほどいてみましょう。
ja.releaseNotes:
• やさしいスタート：レベル1と2ではハートが減らず、ヒントも大きく
• Game Centerへのサインインは初回起動時ではなく、レベル4のあとに
• 新しい名前と国旗がデイリーチャレンジのタイムにも反映されるように
• 修正：「レベルをやり直す」で「続ける」の動画が無駄になる問題

de.description:
Spiel ohne Werbung, wenn du willst: keine zwischen den Levels, keine Banner, und ein kurzes Video nur, wenn du selbst eines startest.

Tippe einen Pfeil an, und er gleitet seinem eigenen Weg nach vom Brett, sofern ihm nichts im Weg steht. Räume alle Pfeile in der richtigen Reihenfolge ab, und das Brett zeigt das Bild, das es die ganze Zeit war: eine Katze, einen Heißluftballon, das Matterhorn.

Arrowgami ist ein entspannendes Logik-Puzzle und Knobelspiel übers Vorausschauen. Jedes Brett ist ein Bild, wie Origami aus Pfeilen gefaltet. Entwirre das Labyrinth: Finde den Pfeil, der hinaus kann, dann den nächsten, und sieh zu, wie sich die Form entfaltet.

• Immer lösbar: Jedes Brett geht auf, die schwersten mit genau einer Lösung. Kein Raten, nur Nachdenken.
• Vier Schwierigkeiten: Normal, Knifflig, Vertrackt und Teuflisch, vom ruhigen Gehirnjogging bis zum Rätsel, das dich richtig fordert, und Bretter in vier Arten: Spiralen, lange Linien, ein Gedränge kurzer Pfeile und die klassische Mischung.
• Täglich eine neue Herausforderung, an Festtagen aus aller Welt mit ihrem eigenen Bild, mit Kalender, Serie und einem Pokal für jeden vollständig gelösten Monat. Dazu jedes Wochenende ein großes Rätsel. Vergleiche deine Zeit mit allen, die sie gelöst haben.
• Über 1000 Bilder zum Sammeln, die in Farbe aufleuchten, in fünfzehn Alben: Tiere und Dinosaurier, Essen, Orte, Sport, Feste und ein paar Schweizer Lieblinge.
• Wöchentliche Ligen unter einem Namen und einer Flagge deiner Wahl, deine Game-Center-Freunde markiert.
• Schick ein Level oder die Tägliche Challenge mit deiner Zeit zum Schlagen und deiner Lösung als Geist: Deine Pfeile fliegen blass neben denen deiner Freunde mit. Auch ohne das Spiel kann man gleich losspielen.
• Medaillen mit je zehn Stufen, Bestzeiten für jedes Level, Erfolge und Ranglisten im Game Center.
• Drei Herzen pro Level, zwei auf den schwersten: Ein blockierter Pfeil prallt zurück und kostet eines.
• Tipps, wenn du nicht weiterkommst, und weitere bei jedem Serien-Meilenstein.
• Auch auf der Apple Watch: Rätsel fürs Handgelenk, jedes ein Bild, die für deine Serie, die Ligen und deine Sammlung zählen, und eine Komplikation mit deiner Serie fürs Zifferblatt.
• Offline spielbar, ohne WLAN. Der Fortschritt synchronisiert über iCloud auf iPhone, iPad und Apple Watch, mit Widgets für Home- und Sperrbildschirm.
• Unterstützt VoiceOver, Sprachsteuerung, Bewegung reduzieren, fetten Text, die größten Schriftgrößen und erhöhten Kontrast.

Arrowgami ist kostenlos, und ein kurzes Video läuft nur, wenn du eines möchtest, für einen zusätzlichen Tipp oder um deine Herzen aufzufüllen und weiterzuspielen. Im Shop gibt es außerdem den Serienschutz, der deine Tagesserie an einem verpassten Tag rettet, die Spielfeld-Themen, vier Orte zum Spielen bei Tag und bei Nacht, die Meisterwerke, sechs berühmte Gemälde hinter deinem Spielfeld, und ein Trinkgeld, wenn du Danke sagen möchtest.

Lade Arrowgami jetzt und entwirre dein erstes Bild.
de.releaseNotes:
• Sanfterer Einstieg: keine Herzen verloren in Level 1 und 2, größere Tipps
• Game Center fragt erst nach Level 4, nicht beim ersten Start
• Dein neuer Name und deine Flagge erscheinen jetzt auch bei der Täglichen Challenge
• Behoben: «Level neu starten» macht ein «Weitermachen»-Video nicht mehr zunichte

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
• 500 pictures: 127 new ones to uncover, and many older ones redrawn so they read better on big boards.
• Your monthly trophies open up close in Awards, and you can share the ones you've won.
• Leagues: while players are still few, groups bring different tiers together, so you're never on your own.
• New sounds: a warm kalimba, and a long run of arrows plays a little tune.
• The difficulties and play modes are explained as you go.

• A free streak freezer for everyone: it covers a day you miss, automatically.
• New boards for the levels ahead, in four kinds: Classic, Coils, Lines and Crowd. Every six levels bring a breather and a tougher spike.
• Pictures light up in colour, and twelve albums give you 3 hints when you complete one.
• 250 new pictures to collect: animals, food, landmarks, holidays from around the world and more.
• Today's Times: compare your daily challenge time with everyone who solved it, and with your Game Center friends.
• Pick a name and a flag for the leagues and Today's Times.
• Past Weeks in the leagues: every week you played, with your place, your points, how close you came to moving up, and its final table.
• Send a level or the daily challenge with your time to beat and your solve to race: your arrows fly beside theirs as faint ghosts, and they see whether they're ahead or behind. Without the game, it opens right away in an App Clip.
• A weekend board: one big picture every weekend, the same for everyone, with its own times. And from December, holidays from around the world in their own pictures.
• Streak milestones pay hints, and a broken streak can still be saved.
• Your first week: seven small goals, one a day, each paying a hint. And every Sunday, a look back at your week to share.
• The new Shop: hints, streak freezers, tips, the Board Themes pack, four places to play in by day and by night, and the Masterpieces pack: six famous paintings behind your board, from Hokusai's Great Wave to Monet's water lilies.
• An evening reminder if you'd like one, a widget for today's daily challenge, and all-time stats in Activity.
• Music while you play: a calm tune in the same key as the arrows' sounds, so every clear fits in. Settings → Music turns it off.
• Three new sound styles to choose from, free: Marimba, Music Box and Vibraphone, whose quick runs bloom as they go. Kalimba stays the default.
• Every screen works at the largest text sizes.

• Arrowgami on Apple Watch: boards made for the wrist, each a picture that fits the screen whole. Every win counts for your streak, the leagues and your collection.
• A complication for your watch face and the Smart Stack: your streak, whether today counts yet, and the next board.
• Pictures found on the watch join your collection and complete albums too.
• Play a level or a daily challenge again to race your own best: your fastest solve flies beside you as a faint ghost, and you see whether you're ahead or behind.
• Race the day's fastest: once you've solved the daily challenge or the weekend board, tap a time in its list and that player's solve flies beside you as a ghost.
• Hear when a Game Center friend beats your time on the daily challenge or the weekend board, and tap to race their solve.
• The daily challenge and the weekend board in Apple's Games app (iOS 26): play them from there and challenge your friends to beat your time.
• Leagues: play on a Monday morning and you join this week's group at once, without waiting for last week's results.
• Smoother play: boards open sooner, pictures light up without a stutter, and the sound style you chose is ready from the first arrow.
• Easier to read and play with the accessibility settings: larger and bold text, increased contrast, shapes besides colours, and reduced motion.
• Fixed: tapping a notification while Arrowgami was in the background could close it.
• Every text in every language read through again.

• Fixed: on iPad in landscape with iOS 27.2, levels didn't appear.
• Fixed: when one of your devices still has an older version, settings such as hidden ghosts no longer reset as your devices sync.
• A daily challenge or weekend board solved in time, but only back online after midnight, still makes its list of times.

• Invite friends: send a friend today's daily challenge from Today or Settings. They get 5 hints to start, and once they've solved 10 levels, you get 5 too, with a streak freezer for every third friend.
• Longer arrows: the levels you haven't reached yet fill their boards with longer arrows. On Fiendish and Diabolical, one or two arrows can move at a time, and Diabolical boards are always large. Levels you've played keep their boards and times.
• Long arrows fly out more calmly.
• League results come sooner: four hours after the week ends instead of twelve. The league says when the week ends and its results come, in your own time.

• 260 new pictures, 1,017 in all.
• New pictures come with the levels you haven't reached yet, and from 1 January in the daily challenge and weekend boards.
• 3 new albums: Dogs, Dinosaurs and Playtime.
• Other albums grow to up to 20 pictures.
• Today tells you when an update fixes a problem.

• Arrow colours, free: 14 palettes for the arrows on the Original board, in Settings → Board.
• Medals pay now: hints for every new rank (a streak freezer for On Fire and Daily Devotee), and past the top rank a star for every step further, each with its reward.
• The three fastest on the daily and the weekend board now win hints.
• Share your daily result as text, without giving the picture away.
• Guess It: challenge a friend with your board, its picture hidden, to guess before solving.
• Send your time back on a friend's challenge: it says how the race went, and the video shows both solves.
• Your arrow colours on Apple Watch too.
• The level list keeps its filter in sight.

• Easier to read: card titles, difficulty names and buttons stand out more.
• At the largest text sizes, Today and the albums fit on iPad, and so does the line at the top of a board on Apple Watch.
• Six languages now speak to every player alike.
• Fixes for words cut short in several languages.

• Redesigned Challenge and Awards tabs for a better overview
• Clearer daily challenge times and league positions
• New Game Center privacy options
• Better zooming on boards
• More languages, and long words that fit at large text sizes
• From 1 January, daily challenges pick their pictures from the whole gallery

• Gentler start: no hearts lost on levels 1 and 2, and bigger tips
• Game Center asks after level 4, not at first launch
• Your new name and flag now show on daily challenge times
• Fixed: Restart no longer undoes a Keep Going video
